recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量成熟顆粒球的核葉呈分離的小圓球狀，葉與葉之間以極細長的絲狀染色質相連（B 圖最明顯），伴隨骨髓性增生，這是 myelokathexis 的典型型態，配合臨床長期中性球低下應想到 WHIM 症候群（CXCR4 突變）。
features: Numerous mature neutrophils with nuclear lobes that are round, pyknotic-appearing and widely separated
Abnormally long, thin, filamentous chromatin strands connecting the nuclear lobes
No true hyperlobulation beyond what is expected; cytoplasm shows normal pink secondary granulation
Hypercellular aspirate with myeloid hyperplasia and a full spectrum of granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms)
Occasional basophilic precursors/plasma-like cells; erythroid and megakaryocytic lineages not distorted in the field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald Giemsa) is hypercellular with myeloid hyperplasia and orderly granulocytic maturation. Many mature granulocytes show nuclei composed of discrete, rounded, condensed lobes joined by abnormally long, thin filamentous chromatin bridges, without overt hyperlobulation or hypogranularity. Blasts are not increased in the fields shown. In the setting of lifelong neutropenia, these findings are consistent with myelokathexis, suggestive of WHIM syndrome (confirmed by CXCR4 mutation in this case).

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic neutrophils are large with ≥6 normally connected lobes and accompanied by megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes, rather than few round lobes on long filaments.

MDS shows hypogranular cytoplasm, pseudo-Pelger-Huët or abnormal segmentation with dysplasia in other lineages and often clonal abnormalities, whereas myelokathexis has well-granulated cells with thread-like interlobar bridges and negative MDS molecular testing.
Apoptotic neutrophils have dense, homogeneous, fused round nuclear fragments without chromatin filaments and are sparse, not a dominant population in a fresh hypercellular marrow.
These show normal-appearing neutrophil nuclei with maturation arrest or normal marrow, lacking the distinctive filamentous interlobar strands.
